items.title_zh: AI 攻克黎曼猜想？Anthropic 数学家宣称已与 Claude 合作完成证明
items.title_en: Anthropic mathematician claims he and Claude produced a proof of the Riemann hypothesis
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，据《科学美国人》报道，当地时间 20 日，Anthropic 数学家莱文特 · 阿尔波格宣称，自己与 AI 模型 Claude 合作，攻克了数学界最著名的难题之一 —— 黎曼猜想。 阿尔波格在个人网站发表声明称：“我相信， 我与 Claude 合作找到了黎曼猜想的证明 。” IT之家注：黎曼猜想由德国数学家伯恩哈德 · 黎曼于 1859 年提出，认为看似随机分布在数轴上的质数，实际上遵循着复杂而有意义的规律。 此后，黎曼猜想成为整个数论研究领域的重要指引，也是数学界 最著名的未解难题 。由于长期缺乏明确的证明思路，研究进展极其有限，就连顶尖数学家也很少花费大量时间直接尝试证明。直到今年 10 月，OpenAI 集中公布的一批数学研究成果中，有一项证明在揭示质数分布规律方面取得重大进展，让攻克黎曼猜想首次看到了突破口。 漫长的求证之路似乎即将走到终点。阿尔波格公布了与 Claude 合作完成的证明，并将其 编写为 Lean 代码 。 据悉，Lean 是一种能够逐步验证数学推理是否正确的编程语言。一旦得到确认，2026 年将成为 AI 数学能力实现飞跃 的一年。 报道说，AI 从此前表现不稳定、甚至难以达到大学生水平，发展到展现出 超越人类的能力 ，数学领域的各个分支都将受到冲击。 阿尔波格称，他的证明不仅解决了黎曼猜想，还证明了范围 远比原始猜想广泛的“广义黎曼猜想” 。 广义黎曼猜想，则意味着整个数学世界蕴藏着无数尚未发现的深层规律。如果这一成果得到确认，对数学界的影响将难以估量，大量以广义黎曼猜想成立为前提的数学结论也将随之得到证实。 阿尔波格的声明既流露出对一个时代结束的伤感，也表达了对未来的期待。“觉得这一切意味着某种终结，是很自然的。对我而言，这意味着 失去了一盏重要的指路明灯 。但研究过程中见证的进展令我如此震撼，让我相信，整个科学界正在迎来远比其更伟大事物的曙光。” 阿尔波格最后写道：“我希望这一证明能让人们 一窥未来的奇迹 ，也让我们感受到，即使是最简单的事物，也将带给我们怎样的喜悦与惊奇。” 参考 论文原文（ https://alpo.ge/remark.pdf ）
items.summary_en: According to Scientific American, Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claimed on the 20th (local time) that he, working with the AI model Claude, solved one of mathematics' most famous problems, the Riemann hypothesis. In a statement on his personal website, Alpöge said: "I believe that, working with Claude, I have found a proof of the Riemann hypothesis." The Riemann hypothesis, proposed by German mathematician Bernhard Riemann in 1859, is one of the most important unsolved problems in number theory. The report notes that among a batch of mathematical results released by OpenAI in October, one proof made major progress in revealing patterns in the distribution of primes. Alpöge published the proof produced with Claude and wrote it in Lean, a programming language that can verify mathematical reasoning step by step. He also said the proof resolves not only the Riemann hypothesis but also the broader "generalized Riemann hypothesis." The report says that if confirmed, 2026 will be the year AI's mathematical capabilities take a leap. Alpöge said the work feels like "losing an important guiding light," but he hopes the proof lets people "glimpse the wonders of the future."
items.why_zh: （推测）若该证明经 Lean 核验与同行评审确认，将标志 AI 在数学研究能力上的跃升；但目前仅为个人声明，尚待独立验证。
items.why_en: (Speculation) If the proof is confirmed through Lean verification and peer review, it would mark a leap in AI's mathematical research capability; for now it is only a personal claim awaiting independent verification.

items.title_zh: 独占特性确认：华为 Mate 系列旗舰机“无缘”OSTA 小星芒、AI 屏等功能
items.title_en: Huawei's Xingmang confirms exclusivity: Mate series will not get 'AI screen' or 'little star' features for now
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，首款为 AI 而生的鸿蒙手机 —— 华为星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 已于昨日下午正式发布 ，叠加国补后 4999 元起。华为星芒品牌总经理刘赫开通微博， 透露最受欢迎的 16G 版本已经在全平台售罄 。 ▲ IT之家开箱：华为全新子品牌星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 手机实拍 IT之家注意到，刘赫还在自己微博的评论区与网友展开了互动，并解答了不少消费者的疑惑。针对大家最关心的星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 首发新功能华为 Mate 系列能否 OTA 支持相关问题，刘赫的回复如下： 能不能反馈一下 Mate 也做一套新图标？ 那我就... 不反馈给他们了 [狗头斜眼] 开玩笑的， 但是我的 AI 屏和星芒⭐他们是没有滴 星芒默认图标啥时候上放给 Mate 系列？ 不给 [狗头斜眼] 这意味着，华为星芒的开山之作 —— OSTA O1 Pro 的全新设计图标、AI 屏和小星芒为独占特性。而新图标有望后续开放给其他系列机型使用，但 AI 屏和小星芒暂时未有相关计划。 参考IT之家此前报道，华为 Mate 90 系列手机和华为 Pura X View 已推送鸿蒙 HarmonyOS 7.0.0.115 版本升级，带来了 AI 快捷栏。 但 Mate 90 系列和 Pura X View 的 AI 快捷栏与星芒手机的功能有所差异，且在外观设计思路上也截然不同 。 相关阅读： 《 华为星芒刘赫：OSTA O1 Pro 最受欢迎的 16G 版本已在全平台售罄，远超预期 》 《 5499 元起，“首款为 AI 而生的鸿蒙手机”华为星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 阔直板正式发布 》 《 华为 Pura X View 阔直板手机获 HarmonyOS 7.0.0.115 升级，桌面 AI 快捷栏如约而至 》 《 华为 Mate 90 系列手机 AI 快捷栏全新交互体验曝光，与星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 风格完全不同 》
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov. 21 that Huawei's Xingmang OSTA O1 Pro, billed as the first HarmonyOS phone built for AI, was officially launched the previous afternoon, starting at 4,999 yuan after national subsidies. Liu He, general manager of the Huawei Xingmang brand, opened a Weibo account and said the most popular 16G version has sold out across all platforms. In comments on Weibo, asked whether the Mate series could get the OSTA O1 Pro's debut features via OTA, Liu replied that Mate users "don't have my AI screen and Xingmang"; asked when Xingmang's default icons would come to the Mate series, he replied "not giving them." IT之家 concludes that the OSTA O1 Pro's newly designed icons, AI screen and "little star" feature are exclusive; the new icons may later be opened to other series, but there are no plans yet for the AI screen and little star. Earlier reports said the Huawei Mate 90 series and Huawei Pura X View have received HarmonyOS 7.0.0.115, bringing an AI quick bar, though its functions and design differ from the Xingmang phone.
items.why_zh: （推测）这说明华为在子品牌首发功能上采取差异化策略，可能影响 Mate 系列用户的升级预期与产品定位讨论。
items.why_en: (Speculation) This suggests Huawei is differentiating features for its sub-brand, which may affect Mate users' upgrade expectations and discussion of product positioning.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek 新一轮千亿级融资落地，梁文锋保留绝对控制权
items.title_en: Report: DeepSeek closes hundred-billion-yuan round, Liang Wenfeng retains control with about 67.42% stake
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，工商信息显示，DeepSeek 运营主体杭州深度求索人工智能基础技术研究有限公司近日完成工商变更，新增股东杭州程砚企业管理咨询合伙企业（有限合伙）。 IT之家查询国家企业信用信息公示系统获悉，杭州深度求索注册资本由 1644.7496 万元增至 1991.8707 万元，增加 347.1211 万元，增幅约 21.1%。 据证券时报援引知情交易人士消息， DeepSeek 本轮融资募资规模区间在 1000 亿元至 1055 亿元 ，投后估值约 6155 亿元。叠加 2026 年 6 月首轮约 510 亿元融资，市场测算其短时间内两轮累计吸纳资金将超 1500 亿元。 据测算， 梁文锋直接及间接持股比例合计约 67.42% ，千亿资本入场并未改变控制权归属 。 作为新增股东的持股平台，杭州程砚也同步完成工商变更，登记出资额增至 343897.9 万元， 同时新增 31 家合伙人 。目前，杭州程砚合计拥有 32 名合伙人，杭州程策商务咨询有限公司仍担任执行事务合伙人。 据悉，杭州程砚的 31 家合伙人横跨互联网、通信运营商、芯片半导体、新能源、消费电子、汽车、家电以及头部 PE / VC，几乎把大模型商业化所需的上游算力与下游场景一次性集齐。 出资比例排在最前面的，是腾讯与宁德时代体系。腾讯旗下上海珩岫商业管理有限公司出资比例 9.5653%，为第一大出资人；宁德时代通过厦门时代怡远（4.9198%）、厦门时代深远（4.4410%）、福建时代泽远（0.2045%）三只基金合计出资同样为 9.5653%，与腾讯并列居前。 紧随其后的是中移投资控股与中信证券投资，各出资 7.6522%；砺思资本相关主体出资 7.1740%，进入前五。 除此之外，合伙人还囊括了中国移动、中国电信、美团龙珠、网易雷火、小红书、携程系、vivo、美的、立讯体系（立臻精密）、吉利产投、兆易创新、中芯聚源、横店资本等；投资机构一端则聚集了博裕、IDG、高榕、君联、正心谷、CPE 源峰、拾象、石溪资本、国寿股权、中金系等。 工商信息显示，杭州程砚的执行事务合伙人仍由杭州程策商务咨询有限公司担任，而梁文锋持有杭州程策 99% 股权。也就是说， 31 家外部股东进入的是持股平台，通过平台间接享有经济收益 ，杭州程策作为普通合伙人控制权牢牢留在创始人一侧。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov. 20 that business registration records show DeepSeek's operating entity, Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Basic Technology Research Co., Ltd., recently completed a registration change adding Hangzhou Chengyan Enterprise Management Consulting Partnership (LP) as a shareholder. According to the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System, registered capital rose from 16.447496 million yuan to 19.918707 million yuan, an increase of 3.471211 million yuan, or about 21.1%. Citing informed traders, Securities Times reported that DeepSeek's new round raised between 100 billion and 105.5 billion yuan at a post-money valuation of about 615.5 billion yuan; combined with a first round of about 51 billion yuan in June 2026, market estimates put the two rounds at over 150 billion yuan in total. Estimates put Liang Wenfeng's direct and indirect stake at about 67.42%, with the large capital inflow not changing control. Hangzhou Chengyan, the new shareholder platform, raised its registered contribution to 3.438979 billion yuan and added 31 partners for a total of 32, with Hangzhou Chengce Business Consulting Co., Ltd. remaining as general partner. The report says the 31 partners span internet, telecom carriers, chips/semiconductors, new energy, consumer electronics, autos, home appliances and leading PE/VC firms. Tencent and CATL's entities lead by contribution: Shanghai Hengxiu Commercial Management Co., Ltd. (Tencent) at 9.5653%, the largest contributor, and CATL through three funds also totaling 9.5653%. They are followed by China Mobile Investment Holdings and CITIC Securities Investment at 7.6522% each, and a Lishi Capital-related entity at 7.1740%. Partners also include China Mobile, China Telecom, Meituan Dragon Ball, NetEase Leihuo, Xiaohongshu, Ctrip-affiliated entities, vivo, Midea, the Luxshare system (Lizhen Precision), Geely Industrial Investment, GigaDevice, SMIC Capital, Hengdian Capital, as well as Boyu, IDG, Gaorong, Legend Capital, Zhengxin Valley, CPE, Shixiang, Shixi Capital, China Life Equity and CICC-affiliated institutions. Registration records show the general partner remains Hangzhou Chengce Business Consulting Co., Ltd., 99% owned by Liang Wenfeng, meaning the 31 external shareholders hold indirect economic interests through the platform.
items.why_zh: （推测）若融资金额属实，创始人保留控制权且合伙人覆盖算力与场景上下游，可能影响国内大模型竞争格局；融资数据来自知情人士消息与市场测算，尚未见公司确认。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，工商信息显示，DeepSeek 运营主体杭州深度求索人工智能基础技术研究有限公司近日完成工商变更，新增股东杭州程砚企业管理咨询合伙企业（有限合伙）。 IT之家查询国家企业信用信息公示系统获悉，杭州深度求索注册资本由 1644.7496 万元增至 1991.8707 万元，增加 347.1211 万元，增幅约 21.1%。 据证券时报援引知情交易人士消息， DeepSeek 本轮融资募资规模区间在 1000 亿元至 1055 亿元 ，投后估值约 6155 亿元。叠加 2026 年 6 月首轮约 510 亿元融资，市场测算其短时间内两轮累计吸纳资金将超 1500 亿元。 据测算， 梁文锋直接及间接持股比例合计约 67.42% ，千亿资本入场并未改变控制权归属 。 作为新增股东的持股平台，杭州程砚也同步完成工商变更，登记出资额增至 343897.9 万元， 同时新增 31 家合伙人 。目前，杭州程砚合计拥有 32 名合伙人，杭州程策商务咨询有限公司仍担任执行事务合伙人。 据悉，杭州程砚的 31 家合伙人横跨互联网、通信运营商、芯片半导体、新能源、消费电子、汽车、家电以及头部 PE / VC，几乎把大模型商业化所需的上游算力与下游场景一次性集齐。 出资比例排在最前面的，是腾讯与宁德时代体系。腾讯旗下上海珩岫商业管理有限公司出资比例 9.5653%，为第一大出资人；宁德时代通过厦门时代怡远（4.9198%）、厦门时代深远（4.4410%）、福建时代泽远（0.2045%）三只基金合计出资同样为 9.5653%，与腾讯并列居前。 紧随其后的是中移投资控股与中信证券投资，各出资 7.6522%；砺思资本相关主体出资 7.1740%，进入前五。 除此之外，合伙人还囊括了中国移动、中国电信、美团龙珠、网易雷火、小红书、携程系、vivo、美的、立讯体系（立臻精密）、吉利产投、兆易创新、中芯聚源、横店资本等；投资机构一端则聚集了博裕、IDG、高榕、君联、正心谷、CPE 源峰、拾象、石溪资本、国寿股权、中金系等。 工商信息显示，杭州程砚的执行事务合伙人仍由杭州程策商务咨询有限公司担任，而梁文锋持有杭州程策 99% 股权。也就是说， 31 家外部股东进入的是持股平台，通过平台间接享有经济收益 ，杭州程策作为普通合伙人控制权牢牢留在创始人一侧。

items.title_zh: Take-Two 前 CEO 费德：《GTA 6》将是 AI 时代前夜最后的“传统”3A 大作
items.title_en: Former Take-Two CEO Feder: GTA 6 may be the last 'traditional' AAA game before the AI era
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，Take-Two 前 CEO 本 · 费德认为，《GTA 6》将成为 AI 时代全面到来前 最后一部采用传统开发模式打造的 3A 大作 ，游戏行业也将由此告别一个时代。 费德在《财富》杂志撰文称：“《GTA 6》的发布将成为一场文化盛事，带来史诗般的游戏体验。我相信它会是一部杰作，但也会是同类作品中的最后一部。” IT之家获悉，他认为，原因并非 R 星的质量把控能力下降，也不是 AI 能让游戏开发更快、更省钱，而是《GTA 6》代表着一种即将 被 AI 颠覆的创作模式的巅峰 。 费德指出，游戏开发过程中，改变方向甚至放弃原有创意，都可能耗费大量时间和技术资源，AI 可以大幅降低改变主意的成本。 费德将 AI 对游戏行业的影响，比作摄影术对绘画的冲击：“摄影术问世时，许多视觉艺术家担心生计受到威胁，其中一些人的担忧确实成真了：委托画家绘制肖像的市场崩溃了。但也有人开始思考另一个问题：接下来我们还能创作什么？摆脱了忠实还原现实的要求后，他们开创了全新甚至颠覆性的艺术形式，包括印象派、立体主义和抽象艺术。我猜想，未来的文化史学家看待《GTA 6》， 就像艺术史学家看待最后一批伟大的写实主义画家一样 。” 在他看来，《GTA 6》是一种创作模式在媒介边界被打破、全新艺术形式涌现之前所达到的最高成就。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov. 20 that former Take-Two CEO Ben Feder believes GTA 6 will be the last AAA game built with traditional development methods before the AI era fully arrives, closing a chapter for the games industry. Writing in Fortune, Feder said: "The launch of GTA 6 will be a cultural event, delivering an epic experience. I believe it will be a masterpiece, but also the last of its kind." He argued the reason is neither a decline in Rockstar's quality control nor AI making games faster and cheaper, but that GTA 6 represents the pinnacle of a creative model about to be disrupted by AI. Feder noted that changing direction or abandoning ideas during development can consume large amounts of time and technical resources, and AI can sharply lower the cost of changing one's mind. He compared AI's impact on games to photography's impact on painting, saying that when photography arrived many visual artists feared for their livelihoods and some of those fears came true as the commissioned-portrait market collapsed, but others asked what else they could create and, freed from the demand for faithful representation, pioneered impressionism, cubism and abstract art. He speculated that future cultural historians will view GTA 6 as art historians view the last great realist painters. In his view, GTA 6 is the highest achievement of a creative model just before media boundaries break and new art forms emerge.

items.why_en: (Speculation) This is one industry veteran's personal view, suggesting AI may change AAA development pipelines and creative methods rather than offering a definitive industry forecast.

items.title_zh: 玩家在《极限竞速：地平线 6》中偶遇已故好友 Drivatar AI 车手，得以再次“并肩驾车”重温昨日时光
items.title_en: Player meets late friend's Drivatar AI driver in Forza Horizon 6
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，《极限竞速：地平线 6（Forza Horizon 6）》玩家 Samohteht 近日分享了一段令人动容的游戏经历。他在游戏中意外遇见了 4 个月前离世的好友留在游戏里的 Drivatar AI 车手，两人得以再次并肩驾车巡航，这段视频在社交平台引发广泛关注，也让不少玩家想起了自己曾通过游戏与故人重逢的经历。 参考 Samohteht 在 Instagram 发布的视频。画面中，他驾车时遇见了好友 Mabel1411 留在游戏里的 Drivatar。随后，两辆车并排行驶，仿佛两人从未天人永隔。 Samohteht 表示：“我最好的朋友在 4 个月前离开了。每隔一段时间，我就会在《极限竞速：地平线 6》里遇见他的 Drivatar。有那么一小段时间，我们又能一起兜风了，不需要言语，没有告别，也没有悲伤，就只是两个朋友并肩开着车，一切（事故）仿佛从未发生过。” Samohteht 形容，这短暂的片刻让世界再次恢复了正常。“我知道这只是一款游戏，但有时候，这已经是我最接近再次见到他的方式了。”最后，他还向好友送上生日祝福：“生日快乐。我很想你，兄弟。” 这段视频在 Instagram 上累计获得超过 177.7 万个赞。Samohteht 随后也向留言的网友表达感谢，称自己收到了太多暖心回应，已经无法逐一回复：“谢谢大家留下这些温暖的话。我们一起纪念了他，他一定会感到骄傲。” 公开信息显示， 《极限竞速》系列中的 Drivatar 是一套能够学习真实玩家驾驶风格的系统。游戏会分析玩家的驾驶习惯，并据此建立相应的 AI 驾驶数据 ，之后该玩家的 Drivatar 便会随机出现在其他人的游戏中。 Drivatar 最早于 2005 年的《极限竞速》（Forza Motorsport）中登场，并在 2013 年推出的《极限竞速 5》（Forza Motorsport 5）中加入在线分享功能。由于这套系统能够保留玩家的驾驶特征，因此即使原玩家已经离世，其 Drivatar 仍可能继续出现在其他玩家的游戏世界里。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov. 20 that Forza Horizon 6 player Samohteht shared an experience in which he unexpectedly encountered the Drivatar AI driver left in the game by a friend who died four months earlier, allowing the two to drive side by side once more; the video drew wide attention on social media. In the video posted on Instagram, Samohteht encounters the Drivatar left by his friend Mabel1411, and the two cars then drive side by side. Samohteht said: "My best friend left four months ago. Every so often I run into his Drivatar in Forza Horizon 6. For a brief moment we get to cruise together again — no words needed, no goodbye, no sadness, just two friends driving side by side." He said the brief moment made the world feel normal again: "I know it's just a game, but sometimes this is the closest I can get to seeing him again." He also wished his friend a happy birthday: "Happy birthday. I miss you, brother." The video has received more than 1.777 million likes on Instagram, and he thanked commenters for their warm words, saying "we remembered him together, and he would be proud." Public information shows that Drivatar in the Forza series learns real players' driving styles: the game analyzes a player's driving habits and builds corresponding AI driving data, after which that player's Drivatar may randomly appear in other players' games. Drivatar debuted in 2005's Forza Motorsport, and online sharing was added in 2013's Forza Motorsport 5. Because the system preserves a player's driving traits, a Drivatar may keep appearing in others' games even after the original player has died.
items.why_zh: （推测）这一事件反映出基于玩家行为数据训练的 AI 角色会在玩家离世后继续留存，可能引发关于数据留存与情感伦理的讨论。
items.why_en: (Speculation) The episode illustrates how AI characters trained on player behavior can persist after a player's death, which may prompt discussion of data retention and emotional ethics.

items.title_zh: 消息称林俊旸从阿里离职后创办的 AI 公司语用科技完成新一轮融资，估值达 50 亿美元
items.title_en: Report: Lin Junyang's Pragmatik Labs raises new round at $5 billion valuation
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，据彭博社报道，林俊旸（yáng）从阿里离职后，今年夏天创立的语用科技 Pragmatik Labs 已完成新一轮融资， 估值达 50 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 334.6 亿元人民币） 。 知情人士透露，语用科技在近期完成的一轮融资中筹集了数千万美元。今年 8 月，该公司在数亿美元的首轮融资中获得 20 亿美元 （现汇率约合 133.84 亿元人民币） 估值。 知情人士称，新晋投资方包括华业天成资本（HyT Capital）、鼎晖投资（CDH Investments）以及汽车制造商吉利汽车控股有限公司。 公开资料显示，出生于 1993 年的林俊旸，曾是阿里最年轻的 P10 级技术专家，与智谱 AI 创始人唐杰、月之暗面（Kimi）创始人杨植麟、腾讯首席 AI 科学家姚顺雨并称为“基模四杰”。今年 3 月，林俊旸宣布从阿里巴巴离职。 据IT之家此前报道，今年 8 月，林俊旸透露语用科技首轮融资由高榕创投和红杉中国共同领投，腾讯和上海未来产业基金提供支持。 相关阅读： 《 从阿里离职五个月后，林俊旸官宣创办 AI 公司语用科技 Pragmatik Labs 》
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov. 20 that, according to Bloomberg, Pragmatik Labs, the AI company Lin Junyang founded this summer after leaving Alibaba, has completed a new funding round at a $5 billion valuation (about 33.46 billion yuan at current exchange rates, per IT之家). People familiar with the matter said Pragmatik raised tens of millions of dollars in the recently completed round. In August, the company reached a $2 billion valuation (about 13.384 billion yuan) in a first round of several hundred million dollars. The people said new investors include HyT Capital, CDH Investments and automaker Geely Automobile Holdings. Public information shows Lin, born in 1993, was Alibaba's youngest P10-level technical expert and, along with Zhipu AI founder Tang Jie, Moonshot (Kimi) founder Yang Zhilin and Tencent chief AI scientist Yao Shunyu, was known as one of the "four masters of foundation models." Lin announced his departure from Alibaba in March this year. IT之家 previously reported that in August Lin said Pragmatik's first round was co-led by Gaorong Ventures and Sequoia China, with support from Tencent and the Shanghai Future Industry Fund.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 上市当天，离职研究员考克森在其总部外呼吁禁止 AI 递归自我改进
items.title_en: On Anthropic's IPO day, former researcher Coxon protests outside HQ calling for a ban on recursive AI self-improvement
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，据《商业内幕》报道，今年 9 月，Anthropic 前研究员雅各布 · 考克森 因担忧 AI 发展而离职 ，并在美国引发了对 AI 技术的广泛恐慌。时间来到当地时间 19 日，随着 Anthropic 股票首次上市交易，考克森再次呼吁公众关注 AI 安全问题。 这次，他在接受采访时强调：“ 他们买不买股票根本不重要。我们必须阻止递归自我改进 。” IT之家注：“递归自我改进”指 让先进 AI 系统参与训练下一代 AI ，从而推动 AI 能力不断提升。 当天，考克森与数十名抗议者聚集在 Anthropic 旧金山总部外，要求禁止有关技术。 抗议者举着标语、高喊口号，现场还有考克森、OpenAI 前研究员丹尼尔 · 科科塔伊洛和 YouTube 博主罗布 · 迈尔斯发表演讲，随后赶到的 Stop AI 组织成员则封堵了办公楼入口。 AI 安全研究机构 METR 近期发布的独立报告发现，AI 正帮助 Anthropic 加快研发进度。Anthropic 也在 IPO 招股说明书中承认， 让 AI 在缺乏监督的情况下完全自主设计下一代模型并不安全 ，目前正在考虑修改政策，确保前沿 AI 模型的开发仍由人类掌控。 考克森认为，仅靠这些措施还不够。他在演讲中呼吁 Anthropic 游说政府，并与其他企业合作， 推动全面禁止递归自我改进 。“到了这个地步，企业本身就是问题。2027 年，全球只有少数几个地方能够实现递归自我改进，而这里就是其中之一。” 考克森和科科塔伊洛都提到，私下里经常听到 AI 研究人员表达对技术风险的担忧。科科塔伊洛形容道：“这种事简直就是漫画里那些 疯狂科学家式的超级反派 才会干的。”
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov. 20 that, according to Business Insider, former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon left the company in September over concerns about AI development and sparked broad alarm about the technology in the US. On the 19th (local time), as Anthropic shares began trading publicly, Coxon again called for public attention to AI safety. In an interview he stressed: "Whether they buy the stock doesn't matter at all. We have to stop recursive self-improvement." IT之家 notes that "recursive self-improvement" refers to having advanced AI systems help train the next generation of AI, driving capabilities ever higher. That day Coxon and dozens of protesters gathered outside Anthropic's San Francisco headquarters demanding a ban on the technology. Protesters held signs and chanted; Coxon, former OpenAI researcher Daniel Kokotajlo and YouTube creator Rob Miles spoke, and members of the group Stop AI who arrived later blocked the office entrance. A recent independent report from AI safety research organization METR found that AI is helping Anthropic speed up R&D. Anthropic also acknowledged in its IPO prospectus that letting AI fully design next-generation models autonomously without oversight is unsafe, and said it is considering policy changes to ensure frontier AI development remains under human control. Coxon argued these measures are not enough, calling in his speech for Anthropic to lobby governments and work with other companies to push for a full ban on recursive self-improvement. "At this point, the companies themselves are the problem. In 2027, only a few places worldwide will be able to achieve recursive self-improvement, and this is one of them." Both Coxon and Kokotajlo said they often hear AI researchers privately express concerns about technology risks. Kokotajlo described it as "the kind of thing only mad-scientist supervillains in comics would do."
items.why_zh: （推测）抗议发生在 Anthropic 上市当天，把“递归自我改进”风险推到公众视野，可能影响 AI 安全监管与企业自律政策的讨论。
items.why_en: (Speculation) The protest on Anthropic's IPO day brought the risk of recursive self-improvement into public view and may shape debate over AI safety regulation and companies' self-imposed policies.

items.summary_en: A new report from the AI evaluation nonprofit METR finds that some AI capabilities are continuing to improve along an exponential trajectory—but it also indicates that models aren’t quite as good at tasks that require judgment as they are at coding. The report is an update to the organization’s time horizon plot, which was widely shared— and widely misinterpreted , owing to the complexity of the measures it used. METR evaluated models by having them attempt a large suite of tasks, each of which had also been completed by humans. Each task’s difficulty was scored by how long it took the human testers to finish it—and then models were rated according to the length of the tasks that they could complete. That plot showed that AI systems were rapidly improving—every four months, the length of the tasks that frontier models could successfully complete doubled. The updated plot adds more tasks—some that are estimated to take humans far longer than those in the original suite, and others that are more open-ended. One of the biggest questions in AI right now is the extent to which progress on “verifiable” tasks—where it’s possible to check automatically whether an AI system has succeeded or failed—carry over into tasks on which success or failure is harder to measure. items.title_zh: Anthropic 上市次日股价下跌 9%，AI 板块雪上加霜
items.title_en: Anthropic shares fall 9% the day after its IPO, deepening the AI sector's slump
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，据路透社报道，当地时间 20 日，Anthropic 上市次日股价下跌，令低迷的 AI 板块雪上加霜。这场备受期待的 IPO，也没能重新点燃投资者的热情。 作为 AI 投资热潮的重要风向标，Anthropic 上市曾被寄予厚望，市场期待借此提振经历一段动荡时期后持续疲软的 AI 板块。 然而，Anthropic 股价报 88.25 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 590.6 元人民币） ， 较上市首日的收盘价下跌约 9% 。公司完全稀释后的估值约为 1.6 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 10.71 万亿元人民币） ，按已发行股份计算的市值则约为 1.2 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 8.03 万亿元人民币） 。 短期内，股价仍可能持续波动。随着上市热潮逐渐退去，投资者开始审视 Anthropic 相当于 过去 12 个月营收约 40 倍 的估值是否合理。 美国合众银行资产管理部门私人市场投资主管考希 · 阿明建议：“我们倾向于对 Anthropic 保持耐心，等公司陆续公布上市后的业绩，再进行评估。” 在他看来，当前估值意味着，市场预期 Anthropic 未来多年都能保持快速增长。 Anthropic 上市也未能扭转市场对 AI 板块的担忧。华尔街主要股指周四大幅收跌，周五的股指期货走势则预示市场可能继续下挫。 美股科技七巨头中，英伟达和 Meta 盘前跌幅均超过 3% ，亚马逊和微软 跌幅超过 2% 。芯片股同样承压， AMD 和闪迪均下跌超过 6%，英特尔跌幅超过 4% 。 市场接下来的关注焦点是 OpenAI 可能进行的 IPO 。OpenAI 此前透露有望于明年上市，届时将再次检验投资者对 AI 股票的兴趣。 散户 19 日当天买卖 Anthropic 股票的交易额约为 7.72 亿美元 （现汇率约合 51.66 亿元人民币） ，创下研究机构 Vanda Research 自 2012 年开始统计以来，IPO 首日散户交易额的最高纪录。 Anthropic 股价大幅波动，让投资者面临两难选择：究竟应该押注股价反弹，还是防范进一步下跌？Anthropic 股票期权预计下周开始交易，可能进一步加剧波动。 德国贝伦贝格银行指数事件主管卡斯滕 · 黑塞指出，目前的市场环境对 Anthropic 并不有利。 竞争加剧也可能削弱投资者的信心。 彭博社最新消息称 ，苹果正在开发一款能够代替用户执行任务的 AI 智能体，准备加入 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Meta 之间的市场竞争。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 20: According to Reuters, Anthropic's share price fell on the second day of trading on the 20th (local time), adding to the malaise in the AI sector. The much-anticipated IPO also failed to reignite investor enthusiasm. As an important bellwether for the AI investment boom, Anthropic's listing had been highly anticipated, with the market hoping it would lift the AI sector that has remained weak after a period of turbulence. However, Anthropic's shares were quoted at $88.25 (IT之家 note: about 590.6 yuan at current exchange rates), down about 9% from the first-day closing price. The company's fully diluted valuation is about $1.6 trillion (about 10.71 trillion yuan), while its market cap based on issued shares is about $1.2 trillion (about 8.03 trillion yuan). The stock may continue to be volatile in the near term. As the listing hype fades, investors are beginning to question whether Anthropic's valuation—roughly 40 times its trailing-12-month revenue—is reasonable. Kaushi Amin, head of private markets investing at U.S. Bank's asset management arm, advised: "We prefer to be patient with Anthropic and wait for the company to report post-IPO results before evaluating it." In his view, the current valuation implies the market expects Anthropic to maintain rapid growth for years to come. Anthropic's listing also failed to reverse market worries about the AI sector. Major Wall Street indexes closed sharply lower on Thursday, and Friday's futures pointed to possible further declines. Among the Magnificent Seven tech stocks, Nvidia and Meta both fell more than 3% in premarket trading, while Amazon and Microsoft fell more than 2%. Chip stocks were also under pressure, with AMD and SanDisk both down more than 6% and Intel down more than 4%. The market's next focus is OpenAI's possible IPO. OpenAI previously indicated it hopes to list next year, which will again test investor appetite for AI stocks. Retail trading in Anthropic shares on the 19th totaled about $772 million (about 5.166 billion yuan), the highest first-day retail trading volume since research firm Vanda Research began tracking in 2012. The sharp swings in Anthropic's stock leave investors with a dilemma: bet on a rebound or guard against further declines? Anthropic stock options are expected to begin trading next week, which could add to volatility. Carsten Hesse, head of index events at Germany's Berenberg Bank, noted that the current market environment is not favorable for Anthropic. Intensifying competition could also weaken investor confidence. Bloomberg's latest report says Apple is developing an AI agent that can perform tasks on users' behalf, preparing to join the competition among OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta.

items.why_en: Anthropic is seen as a bellwether for AI investment, and its post-IPO decline may reflect investors reassessing high valuations and sentiment toward the AI sector (speculation).
items.source_title: Anthropic 上市次日股价下跌 9%，AI 板块雪上加霜
items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，据路透社报道，当地时间 20 日，Anthropic 上市次日股价下跌，令低迷的 AI 板块雪上加霜。这场备受期待的 IPO，也没能重新点燃投资者的热情。 作为 AI 投资热潮的重要风向标，Anthropic 上市曾被寄予厚望，市场期待借此提振经历一段动荡时期后持续疲软的 AI 板块。 然而，Anthropic 股价报 88.25 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 590.6 元人民币） ， 较上市首日的收盘价下跌约 9% 。公司完全稀释后的估值约为 1.6 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 10.71 万亿元人民币） ，按已发行股份计算的市值则约为 1.2 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 8.03 万亿元人民币） 。 短期内，股价仍可能持续波动。随着上市热潮逐渐退去，投资者开始审视 Anthropic 相当于 过去 12 个月营收约 40 倍 的估值是否合理。 美国合众银行资产管理部门私人市场投资主管考希 · 阿明建议：“我们倾向于对 Anthropic 保持耐心，等公司陆续公布上市后的业绩，再进行评估。” 在他看来，当前估值意味着，市场预期 Anthropic 未来多年都能保持快速增长。 Anthropic 上市也未能扭转市场对 AI 板块的担忧。华尔街主要股指周四大幅收跌，周五的股指期货走势则预示市场可能继续下挫。 美股科技七巨头中，英伟达和 Meta 盘前跌幅均超过 3% ，亚马逊和微软 跌幅超过 2% 。芯片股同样承压， AMD 和闪迪均下跌超过 6%，英特尔跌幅超过 4% 。 市场接下来的关注焦点是 OpenAI 可能进行的 IPO 。OpenAI 此前透露有望于明年上市，届时将再次检验投资者对 AI 股票的兴趣。 散户 19 日当天买卖 Anthropic 股票的交易额约为 7.72 亿美元 （现汇率约合 51.66 亿元人民币） ，创下研究机构 Vanda Research 自 2012 年开始统计以来，IPO 首日散户交易额的最高纪录。 Anthropic 股价大幅波动，让投资者面临两难选择：究竟应该押注股价反弹，还是防范进一步下跌？Anthropic 股票期权预计下周开始交易，可能进一步加剧波动。 德国贝伦贝格银行指数事件主管卡斯滕 · 黑塞指出，目前的市场环境对 Anthropic 并不有利。 竞争加剧也可能削弱投资者的信心。 彭博社最新消息称 ，苹果正在开发一款能够代替用户执行任务的 AI 智能体，准备加入 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Meta 之间的市场竞争。

items.title_en: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen
items.summary_zh: iOS 上的 Signal 用户会看到这一选项，可切换为阻止截屏并阻止 Siri AI 扫描屏幕内容。Signal 正在限制 Android 和 iOS 设备上的截屏能力，以防止 AI 智能体读取用户消息和其他数据。Signal 总裁 Meredith Whittaker 在博客文章中表示，操作系统内置的、通过分析屏幕信息来更多了解用户的智能体 AI 能力，正在“削弱 Signal 独立保障隐私的能力”，她并呼吁操作系统提供商让应用开发者更容易控制智能体能访问哪些数据。“我们想非常明确地表示：Signal——以及其他应用开发者——缺乏有力工具来阻止 AI 时代……这是一个严重问题。”（完整报道见 The Verge）

items.title_zh: 开发者将櫻井政博游戏制作教程整合为 Skill 技能，可供各类 AI 智能体调用
items.title_en: Developer packages Masahiro Sakurai's game-making tutorials into a Skill that AI agents can call
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，日本开发者 kociden 近日在 GitHub 上公开了一款名为「sakurai-skill」的非官方项目，将知名游戏制作人樱井政博 YouTube 频道《樱井政博的游戏制作》（桜井政博のゲーム作るには）全 257 集正片及特别合作视频的字幕内容，整理为 AI 智能体 Skill 技能文件，用于辅助开发。 公开信息显示，《樱井政博的游戏制作》是《星之卡比》和《任天堂明星大乱斗》系列制作人樱井政博开设的 YouTube 频道，于 2024 年 10 月 22 日结束更新。频道主要分享樱井政博多年积累的游戏开发经验与设计理论，共推出 256 集正片及 3 集特别合作视频。 具体来看，这位开发者 kociden 将樱井政博频道 257 集视频的字幕进行整理成一份约 2.7 万字的主文件，涵盖 14 个章节的游戏设计原则及操作手感调整流程。这些内容主要围绕樱井政博分享过的游戏性、游戏企划、动作设计、特效、用户界面（UI）及音效等领域展开。AI 可以根据开发者当前的需求，按需读取对应类别的参考文件，而不必一次性加载全部内容。 开发者希望，这套技能能够帮助游戏开发者处理游戏企划、难度设计、奖励配置、新手引导以及打击感调整等工作。例如，开发者可以直接向 AI 提问「樱井先生会怎么做？」或要求「请帮我检查这款游戏的操作手感」，让 AI 调用相应设计原则，对游戏进行分析并提出修改建议。 为了展示项目的实际效果，kociden 还公开了使用「sakurai-skill」制作的游戏案例《ハジキ》。该作品使用 Godot 4.6.3 游戏引擎从零开始开发，重点展示了这套技能在游戏操作手感设计方面的实际应用。 不过，kociden 特别强调，「sakurai-skill」属于非官方同人项目，与樱井政博本人没有任何关联。项目内容是 AI 根据 YouTube 自动生成字幕总结而成，并非樱井政博本人的逐字原话，因此可能存在语音识别错误或内容理解偏差。 开发者还提醒，樱井政博分享的设计原则主要基于大型游戏及动作游戏的开发经验，因此并不一定适用于所有游戏类型和开发规模。开发者不应盲目照搬这些原则，而应根据自身项目的实际情况灵活调整，始终以「让玩家感受到乐趣」这一核心目标为出发点。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 20: Japanese developer kociden recently published an unofficial project called "sakurai-skill" on GitHub, turning the subtitles of all 257 main and special collaboration videos from well-known game producer Masahiro Sakurai's YouTube channel "Sakurai Masahiro's Game Making" (桜井政博のゲーム作るには) into an AI agent Skill file to assist development. Public information shows that the channel, run by Sakurai—producer of the Kirby and Super Smash Bros. series—stopped updating on October 22, 2024. It mainly shares Sakurai's years of game development experience and design theory, with 256 main episodes and 3 special collaboration videos. Specifically, kociden compiled subtitles from the channel's 257 videos into a main file of about 27,000 characters, covering 14 chapters of game design principles and control-feel tuning workflows. The content centers on areas Sakurai has discussed, including game feel, game planning, action design, effects, user interface (UI) and sound. AI can read the reference file for a given category on demand according to the developer's current needs, rather than loading everything at once. The developer hopes the skill will help game developers with game planning, difficulty design, reward placement, onboarding tutorials and hit-feel tuning. For example, developers can ask the AI "What would Sakurai-san do?" or request "Please check this game's control feel," so the AI calls on the relevant design principles to analyze the game and suggest changes. To demonstrate the project's practical effect, kociden also released a game example made with "sakurai-skill" called 《ハジキ》. Built from scratch with the Godot 4.6.3 engine, it highlights the skill's practical application in designing control feel. However, kociden stressed that "sakurai-skill" is an unofficial fan project with no connection to Sakurai himself. Its content was summarized by AI from YouTube's auto-generated subtitles, not Sakurai's verbatim words, so speech-recognition errors or misinterpretations are possible. The developer also cautioned that Sakurai's design principles are based mainly on experience with large-scale and action games, so they may not suit all game genres and development scales. Developers should not copy them blindly but adapt them flexibly to their own projects, always starting from the core goal of "letting players feel the fun."
items.why_zh: 反映出专家内容被整理为 AI 智能体可调用“技能”的趋势，同时凸显非官方整理与准确性的边界（推测）。
items.why_en: It reflects a trend of packaging expert content into callable "skills" for AI agents, while highlighting the limits of unofficial curation and accuracy (speculation).

items.title_zh: 自家人都看不下去了？数百谷歌员工要求公司允许中小学使用不含 AI 的谷歌搜索
items.title_en: Hundreds of Google employees ask the company to let K-12 schools use AI-free Google Search
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，当地时间 19 日，据彭博社报道，超过 500 名谷歌员工和合同工联名请愿，要求公司允许中小学继续使用不含 AI 功能的谷歌搜索。 请愿书致谷歌 CEO 桑达尔 · 皮查伊、搜索业务负责人伊丽莎白 · 里德和教育业务负责人克里斯 · 菲利普斯。活动由 Alphabet 员工工会发起，其代表着 Alphabet 及旗下谷歌、YouTube 等公司的全职员工、临时工、供应商人员和合同工。 员工在请愿书中警告：如果学校不愿使用 AI，就不让它们使用谷歌搜索， 只会让谷歌更难说服用户 ，学校甚至可能因此彻底弃用谷歌产品。 此前，谷歌决定扩大校园 AI 服务的覆盖范围，让许多中小学生能够使用 Gemini。此举遭到教育工作者、家长和政策制定者质疑，他们担心 AI 会削弱学生的批判性思维能力，使孩子不再主动查找 AI 生成答案以外的信息。 谷歌回应称，公司与学校保持密切合作，以确保产品能够帮助学生和教师。“我们理解家长和教师担心学生利用 AI 在学习中走捷径，我们的目标是一致的：帮助学生学习。” 为进一步打消家长和学校的顾虑，谷歌计 划默认关闭面向学生的 AI 功能 。但学校如果想继续使用谷歌搜索， 可能仍然必须接受内置 AI 功能的版本 。 谷歌管理层认为，如果不向学生提供 AI 功能，其他公司也会抢先采取类似做法，且可能更加“不负责任”。不过，部分谷歌员工并不认同这一理由。 也有员工质疑，推出不带生成式 AI 功能的谷歌搜索版本，在技术上 是否真的无法实现 。 相关阅读： 《 学校不用 Gemini 就不能用搜索？谷歌新规引发美国政界人士批评 》 《 谷歌调整美国中小学账户设置：要么开放 AI 搜索，要么彻底禁用搜索 》
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 20: On the 19th (local time), Bloomberg reported that more than 500 Google employees and contract workers signed a petition asking the company to let K-12 schools continue using a version of Google Search without AI features. The petition is addressed to Google CEO Sundar Pichai, search head Elizabeth Reid and education head Chris Phillips. The campaign was launched by the Alphabet Workers Union, which represents full-time employees, temps, vendors and contract workers at Alphabet and its Google, YouTube and other companies. In the petition, employees warned that denying schools Google Search if they don't want AI will only make it harder for Google to persuade users, and schools might abandon Google products entirely. Previously, Google decided to expand campus AI services so that many K-12 students can use Gemini. The move drew questions from educators, parents and policymakers worried that AI would weaken students' critical-thinking skills and stop children from seeking information beyond AI-generated answers. Google responded that it works closely with schools to ensure products help students and teachers. "We understand parents' and teachers' concerns that students may use AI to take shortcuts in learning, and our goal is the same: helping students learn." To further address parents' and schools' concerns, Google plans to turn off AI features for students by default. But schools that want to keep using Google Search may still have to accept the version with built-in AI features. Google management argues that if it doesn't offer AI features to students, other companies will rush to do the same and may be more "irresponsible." Some Google employees disagree with that reasoning. Some also question whether it is truly technically impossible to release a version of Google Search without generative AI features. Related reading: "Can't use Search without Gemini? Google's new rule draws criticism from US politicians"; "Google adjusts US K-12 account settings: either AI Search or no Search at all."

items.title_zh: 三星电子高管：Neocloud 风险有限，AI 投资基于实际需求
items.title_en: Samsung Executives: Neocloud Risks Are Limited, and AI Investment Is Driven by Real Demand
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，据路透社当地时间 18 日报道，三星电子两位高管在本周举行的摩根士丹利会议上表示 Neocloud（新兴 AI 云服务企业）面临的不确定性对整体市场的影响有限，这轮 AI 投资基于实际需求而非投机。 三星 DS（设备解决方案，半导体板块）部门经营战略总管负责人 Kim Yong-kwan 表示，Neocloud 的“市占份额”仅约为 8%， 对此类企业的担忧不会对 AI 整体发展轨迹构成重大威胁 。这位高管并未详述作为市占计算基础的“市场”具体指什么。 三星晶圆代工销售营销主管 Kang Suk-chae 则认为，当前的 AI 投资热潮是结构性的，源自实在的需求而非投机冲动。 芯片短缺的局面“在可预见的未来仍将持续” ，长期合同使供需双方之间的关系更加明朗。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 20: According to Reuters on the 18th, two Samsung Electronics executives said at a Morgan Stanley conference this week that the uncertainty facing Neoclouds (emerging AI cloud service companies) has a limited impact on the overall market, and that this round of AI investment is based on real demand rather than speculation. Kim Yong-kwan, head of business strategy for Samsung's DS (Device Solutions, semiconductor) division, said Neoclouds hold only about 8% "market share," so concerns about such companies do not pose a major threat to the overall trajectory of AI. The executive did not elaborate on precisely what "market" the share is based on. Kang Suk-chae, head of sales and marketing for Samsung Foundry, argued that the current AI investment boom is structural, stemming from genuine demand rather than speculative impulse. The chip shortage will "continue for the foreseeable future," and long-term contracts have made the supply-demand relationship clearer.
items.why_zh: 高管判断若成立，围绕 Neocloud 的担忧对 AI 基础设施投资节奏的实际影响或有限（推测，基于二手报道）；高管未说明市占统计口径。
items.why_en: If the executives' assessment holds, concerns about Neoclouds may have limited real impact on the pace of AI infrastructure investment (speculation, based on secondhand reporting); the executives did not specify how market share was measured.

items.title_en: ECB President Lagarde: AI Is Intensifying Cyberattack Threats and Keeps Me Awake at Night
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，据路透社报道，当地时间 20 日，欧洲央行行长克里斯蒂娜 · 拉加德发出警告，随着 AI 智能体日益先进，网络攻击的威胁也随之加剧，可能成为全球金融业当前面临的最大挑战。 拉加德在法兰克福举行的欧洲银行业大会上坦言，政策制定者尚未充分重视这一威胁。“ 真正让我和在座许多人夜不能寐的，就是 AI 与网络威胁的结合 。” 综合IT之家此前报道，当地时间 19 日，欧盟委员会证实 遭受了利用 AI 工具进行的网络攻击 。有关此事的调查尚未结束，事态规模暂难判断。 今年 10 月，法国数百家超市的商用冷藏柜和冷冻柜因黑客攻击停运。此前，驶往美国的船只、美国的水处理厂和洛杉矶的公共交通系统也分别在 8 月、7 月和 3 月因遭到黑客攻击而中断运行。 此外， 全美范围的航班一度暂停起飞数小时 ，银行和微软的应用程序也出现无法使用的情况。技术专家认为，这些中断是紧急修补新发现的软件漏洞所致。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 20: According to Reuters, on the 20th European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde warned that as AI agents become increasingly advanced, the threat of cyberattacks is also intensifying and could become the biggest challenge currently facing the global financial industry. Speaking at the European Banking Congress in Frankfurt, Lagarde said policymakers have not yet given the threat sufficient attention. "What really keeps me and many people in this room awake at night is the combination of AI and cyber threats." IT之家 previously reported that on the 19th the European Commission confirmed it had suffered a cyberattack carried out using AI tools; the investigation is not yet concluded and the scale is difficult to judge. In October, commercial refrigerators and freezers in hundreds of French supermarkets stopped operating due to a hack. Previously, ships bound for the US, a US water treatment plant and the Los Angeles public transit system were disrupted by hacks in August, July and March respectively. In addition, flights across the US were briefly grounded for several hours, and banking and Microsoft apps became unavailable. Technology experts believe these outages resulted from emergency patching of newly discovered software vulnerabilities.
items.why_zh: 央行行长公开把 AI 与网络威胁的组合列为金融业核心风险之一，若推动监管议程或改变行业安全要求（推测，摘要未提及具体政策）。

items.title_zh: AMD XDNA2 NPU 率先获得 Unsloth Desktop 适配，支持超百款智能体
items.title_en: AMD XDNA 2 NPU First to Gain Unsloth Desktop Support, Enabling Over 100 Agents
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，AMD 当地时间 19 日宣布，其锐龙 AI 处理器上的 "XDNA 2" NPU 成为 首款获得 Unsloth Desktop 本地界面支持的神经网络处理器 。 具体来看，兼容的应用程序向 Unsloth Desktop API 发送模型请求，而 Lemonade 和 FastFlowLM 则在 AMD XDNA 2 NPU 上处理模型服务和推理。模型的响应返回给应用程序，供其工作流程使用。 这意味着 OpenClaw、Hermes 等超百款智能体可通过 Unsloth Desktop 在锐龙 AI 处理器的 NPU 上本地运行， 从 CPU 和 GPU 上卸载相关 AI 工作负载 ，留出更多算力以供其它任务使用，也有助于延长带电池设备的续航。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 20: AMD announced on the 19th that the "XDNA 2" NPU in its Ryzen AI processors is the first neural processing unit to gain support for the Unsloth Desktop local interface. Specifically, compatible applications send model requests to the Unsloth Desktop API, while Lemonade and FastFlowLM handle model serving and inference on the AMD XDNA 2 NPU. Model responses are returned to the applications for use in their workflows. This means more than 100 agents, including OpenClaw and Hermes, can run locally on the NPU of Ryzen AI processors via Unsloth Desktop, offloading related AI workloads from the CPU and GPU, freeing up compute for other tasks and helping extend battery life on battery-powered devices.
items.why_zh: 把智能体推理从 CPU、GPU 卸载到 NPU，可能改善本地 AI 的能效与续航，但厂商未给出实测数据（推测，基于厂商说法）。
items.why_en: Offloading agent inference from CPU and GPU to the NPU could improve local AI energy efficiency and battery life, though the vendor provided no measured data (speculation, based on the vendor's claims).

items.summary_zh: Google 正在更新其首页以加入 AI 搜索功能。在产品副总裁 Robby Stein 发布于 X 的帖子中，他展示了用户现在可以打开一个可折叠侧边栏来查看并继续自己的 AI 对话。从 Stein 分享的 GIF 看，用户似乎可以点击屏幕左侧出现的灰色条打开该侧边栏。在那里，Google 会显示用户此前通过 AI Mode 进行的搜索列表，并提供新建对话、搜索历史对话或连接 Gemini Notebook 的功能。Google 桌面端首页的这项更新正在全球范围推出。完整报道见 The Verge。
items.summary_en: Google is updating its homepage to include AI searches. IT之家 noted that Liu He, general manager of the Huawei Xingmang brand, has opened a Weibo account and posted at 00:10 to report on the first-sale progress of the brand’s first product, the OSTA O1 Pro: As of now, the most popular 16GB version has sold out across all platforms, far exceeding our expectations! The 12GB version is also continuing to sell well on various platforms; only some stores and platform partners have stock. We are currently working full out to coordinate production capacity and production flexibility across versions. Thank you for your support and trust! Referring to IT之家’s earlier report yesterday, the OSTA O1 Pro comes in three colors — Starry Purple, Nebula White and Starry Black; it features a 6.39-inch 16:9.5 1.5K LTPS flat screen; a rear 200MP 1/1.28-inch RYYB main camera + 50MP 3.7X RYYB periscope telephoto + Red Maple lens. The new phone also carries the Kirin 9030S flagship τ chip, offers up to 16GB+1TB, has a built-in 7000mAh battery, supports 66W wired charging + wireless charging; it debuts with HarmonyOS 7 AI Pioneer Edition, supporting new AI interaction, proactive system intelligence and long-term companion growth. items.title_zh: 加州禁令引发连锁反应，Waymo 暂停全美 Robotaxi 高速公路服务
items.title_en: California ban triggers chain reaction as Waymo pauses robotaxi highway service nationwide
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，当地时间 18 日，据英国《卫报》报道，Alphabet 旗下的 Waymo 在美国全面暂停了无人驾驶出租车的高速公路服务，恢复时间未定。此前，加州因 Waymo 车辆近期发生的交通事件，禁止其在州内高速公路行驶，Waymo 随后将暂停范围扩大至全美。 Waymo 此前在旧金山湾区、洛杉矶、凤凰城、迈阿密和奥斯汀提供高速公路无人驾驶出租车服务，并在拉斯维加斯、达拉斯和丹佛等多个地区运营城市道路乘车服务，面向城区的服务此次不受影响。 Waymo 发言人通过电子邮件回应称，公司暂时停止了所有运营市场的商业无人驾驶高速公路服务，但仍会让经过培训的自动驾驶专员坐在驾驶位，继续开展高速公路测试。暂停措施从 11 月 11 日开始实施，发言人没有透露恢复时间。 同一天，加州机动车管理局也禁止 Waymo 无人驾驶出租车在州内高速公路行驶。该局发言人乔纳森 · 格罗夫曼指出，禁令与两起交通事件有关，其中一起是 3 辆 Waymo 无人驾驶车辆闯入施工区域。 其中，施工区域事件发生在 11 月 5 日，另一起事件发生在 6 日，涉及加州公路巡警车辆，地点位于旧金山的一条高速公路。 11 月 6 日事件的视频上周在社交媒体上广泛传播。画面显示，一辆 Waymo 试图绕过正在实施临时交通管制的加州公路巡警车辆 。 格罗夫曼指出，Waymo 车辆多次闯入仍在施工的区域，现场有施工人员、车辆和设备。加州机动车管理局因此认定，Waymo 的无人驾驶高速公路运营对公共安全构成直接威胁。而在 5 月 18 日，就已经发生了类似事件。 Waymo 发言人则称，近期车辆在加州 101 号公路施工区域发生的事件没有造成人员受伤或车辆碰撞。 格罗夫曼指出，加州禁令不仅禁止 Waymo 在高速公路运营无人驾驶车辆， 也禁止开展无人驾驶测试 。只有 Waymo 向监管部门证明采取了有效整改措施，解决引发禁令的问题后，限制措施才会解除。 相关阅读： 《 美国加州叫停 Waymo 高速公路运营：无人驾驶出租车曾试图超越公路巡警 》
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov 20 that, per the UK's The Guardian on Nov 18 local time, Alphabet-owned Waymo fully suspended its driverless taxi highway service across the United States, with no set resumption date. Earlier, California barred Waymo vehicles from driving on highways in the state because of recent traffic incidents involving its cars, after which Waymo widened the pause nationwide. Waymo had offered highway robotaxi service in the San Francisco Bay Area, Los Angeles, Phoenix, Miami and Austin, and operated city-street ride services in Las Vegas, Dallas and Denver among other areas; city-facing service is unaffected this time. A Waymo spokesperson said the company temporarily halted commercial driverless highway service in all markets where it operates, but will keep conducting highway testing with trained autonomous specialists in the driver's seat; the pause took effect on Nov 11 and the spokesperson did not disclose a resumption date. The same day, the California Department of Motor Vehicles also barred Waymo robotaxis from state highways. A DMV spokesperson (rendered in the report as 乔纳森·格罗夫曼 / Jonathan) said the ban is tied to two traffic incidents, one of which involved three Waymo driverless vehicles entering a construction zone. The construction-zone incident occurred on Nov 5; the other took place on Nov 6 and involved a California Highway Patrol vehicle on a San Francisco highway. Video of the Nov 6 incident circulated widely on social media last week, showing a Waymo attempting to get around a CHP vehicle that was conducting temporary traffic control. The spokesperson said Waymo vehicles repeatedly entered areas where construction workers, vehicles and equipment were still present, and the DMV therefore concluded that Waymo's driverless highway operations pose a direct threat to public safety; a similar incident had already occurred on May 18. A Waymo spokesperson said the recent incidents in a construction zone on California State Route 101 caused no injuries or vehicle collisions. The spokesperson also said California's ban prohibits Waymo not only from operating driverless vehicles on highways but also from conducting driverless testing; restrictions will be lifted only after Waymo proves to regulators that it has taken effective corrective measures addressing the issues behind the ban.
items.why_zh: 加州监管机构以公共安全为由直接叫停高速公路无人驾驶运营，Waymo 随即将暂停扩大至全美，可能影响 robotaxi 商业化与公众信任（推测）。
items.why_en: California regulators citing public safety directly halted driverless highway operations, and Waymo widened the pause nationwide, which could affect robotaxi commercialization and public trust (speculation).

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，华为常务董事、产品投资评审委员会主任、终端 BG 董事长余承东发文表示，享界 V8 上市 2 小时，大定突破 2216 台。 享界 V8 今天正式上市！ 上市 2 小时，大定突破 2216 台 ！感谢大家的支持。 这台 MPV 很多设计巧思，都来自家庭用户真实的用车需求。674L 超大后备箱带下沉空间，婴儿车不用折叠就能直接放下，7 人满载还能装下 10 个 20 寸行李箱；全系标配 ±12° 后轮转向，这么大的车，窄路掉头也很轻松；首创三排五重安全防护，把每一个座位都照顾到。 这些细节都是享界 V8 为家而生的 100 个设计的一部分，百份设计，百分诚意！ 今天上市即交付 ，祝大家早日喜提爱车，也期待收到大家的驾乘反馈。 据IT之家此前报道，在今天下午的鸿蒙智行享界 V8 及星芒品牌发布会上，享界 V8 正式上市，售价 31.98 万元起。 享界 V8 Ultra+ 增程版 39.98 万元起 | 纯电版 42.98 万元起 四驱 + 双腔空簧 + 双阀连续可变阻尼减振器 四激光雷达 | L3 级自动驾驶架构设计 | 二排旋转零重力座椅 享界 V8 Ultra 增程版 35.98 万元起 | 纯电版 38.98 万元起 21.4 英寸华为云晰柔光吸顶屏 四激光雷达 | L3 级自动驾驶架构设计 享界 V8 Max+ 增程版 34.98 万元起 四驱 + 双腔空簧 + 双阀连续可变阻尼减振器 共光路舱内激光雷达 | 21.4 英寸华为云晰柔光吸顶屏 享界 V8 Max 增程版 31.98 万元起 | 纯电版 34.98 万元起 增程标配 56 度电池 | 纯电标配 120 度电池 共光路舱内激光雷达 | 全系标配 ±12° 后轮转向 享界 V8 车身尺寸为 5335/2005/1805mm，轴距 3250mm，采用 2+2+3 七座布局；除 Max+ 外，享界 V8 其余版本均可选 800V 增程或 800V 纯电动力。 纯电版搭载 120 kWh 电池，CLTC 工况续航最高达 830km，四驱版续航为 775km。 增程版搭载 1.5T 增程器，最大功率 118kW，提供 56kWh 与 75.4kWh 两种电池规格，WLTC 纯电续航分别为 260km、275km 和 339km，CLTC 综合续航超过 1400km。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on Nov 20 that Yu Chengdong, Huawei's executive director, chairman of the Product Investment Review Committee and chairman of the Terminal BG, said in a post that orders for the Xiangjie V8 exceeded 2,216 units within two hours of launch. He said many design ideas in the MPV come from real family usage needs: a 674L oversized trunk with underfloor space that fits a stroller without folding and holds ten 20-inch suitcases with seven people aboard; standard ±12° rear-wheel steering across the range; and a first-of-its-kind three-row, five-layer safety protection. He described these details as part of the Xiangjie V8's 100 designs "born for the family," and said deliveries begin on launch day. IT之家 previously reported that the Xiangjie V8 officially launched at that afternoon's HIMA Xiangjie V8 and Xingmang brand event, starting at 319,800 yuan. Versions: Xiangjie V8 Ultra+ extended-range from 399,800 yuan and battery-electric from 429,800 yuan, with four-wheel drive, dual-chamber air suspension, dual-valve continuously variable dampers, four lidars, an L3 autonomous-driving architecture design and rotating zero-gravity second-row seats; Ultra extended-range from 359,800 yuan and BEV from 389,800 yuan, with a 21.4-inch Huawei Yunxi soft-light ceiling screen, four lidars and an L3 autonomous-driving architecture design; Max+ extended-range from 349,800 yuan, with four-wheel drive, dual-chamber air suspension, dual-valve continuously variable dampers, a common-optical-path in-cabin lidar and the 21.4-inch ceiling screen; Max extended-range from 319,800 yuan and BEV from 349,800 yuan, with a 56 kWh battery standard on extended-range and 120 kWh standard on BEV, a common-optical-path in-cabin lidar, and standard ±12° rear-wheel steering across the range. The body measures 5335/2005/1805mm with a 3250mm wheelbase and a 2+2+3 seven-seat layout; all versions except Max+ offer 800V extended-range or 800V battery-electric powertrains. The BEV uses a 120 kWh battery with up to 830km CLTC range (775km for the four-wheel-drive version); the extended-range version uses a 1.5T range extender with 118kW maximum power, offers 56kWh and 75.4kWh battery options, 260km, 275km and 339km WLTC electric range respectively, and over 1,400km CLTC combined range.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，文远知行今日发布 2026 财年（2026 年 1 月～2026 年 12 月）前三季度（2026 年 1 月～2026 年 9 月）及第三财季（2026 年 7 月～2026 年 9 月）报告： 2026 财年前三季度 营业总收入 ：6.67 亿元 毛利润 ：2.65 亿元 毛利率 ：39.6% 归母净利润 ：-11 亿元 基本每股收益 ：-1.11 元 资产负债率 ：20.55% 2026 财年第三财季 营业总收入 ：3.21 亿元，同比增长 88%，环比增长 38.8% 毛利润 ：1.38 亿元 毛利率 ：43% 归母净利润 ：-3.1 亿元 基本每股收益 ：-0.32 元 资产负债率 ：20.55% AI 解读 文远知行 2026 年第三季度及前三季度业绩大幅超出市场机构预期，单季营收显著高于此前机构一致预期的 2.7 亿元水平，盈利能力提升幅度超预期。 公司业务与本季核心亮点 文远知行是全球领先的自动驾驶科技公司，业务覆盖 Robotaxi、L2++/L3 智能驾驶解决方案、AI 基础设施三大板块，同时布局 Robobus、Robosweeper 等 L4 级应用场景。 单第三财季：单季总营收达 3.22 亿元，同比增长 88%，环比增长 38.8%；毛利率提升至 43%，同比提升 10.1% 个百分点；Robotaxi 单季收入首次突破人民币 1 亿元，同比增长 204.0%，其中来自海外业务的收入占比超过 90%；广州 Robotaxi 运营实现单车单位经济效益转正。 前三季度累计：前三季度累计营收达 6.67 亿元，累计毛利润为 2.65 亿元，累计毛利率为 39.6%。 海外业务高速增长：单季海外业务收入达 1.47 亿元，同比增长 171.5%，占总收入的 45.7%；获得西班牙首张国家级 L4 级自动驾驶乘用车运营牌照，中东车队规模扩展至约 600 辆，成为 Uber 在美国以外最大的自动驾驶合作伙伴。 量产业务加速落地：WRD 3.0 L2++/L3 解决方案累计交付突破 10 万套，本季度新增 10 个量产定点，搭载该方案的多款量产车型已上市。 AI 基础设施业务翻倍增长：旗下景烁科技面向具身智能、机器人、自动驾驶客户提供全链路数据解决方案，业务收入同比增长近一倍。 盈利与现金流情况 单第三财季毛利润为 1.38 亿元，期内亏损为 3.1 亿元，非国际财务报告准则经调整期内亏损为 3.37 亿元，EBITDA 为 -246.4 百万元，较去年同期亏损收窄 2.9%；每股普通股基本及摊薄亏损为 0.32 元。 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，公司持有现金及现金等价物、定期存款、理财产品投资及受限制现金合计 46.63 亿元，管理层表示现有现金储备可支撑四年以上运营，足以支持公司实现自我造血。 展望与投资价值 公司当前已在 13 个国家开展运营、9 个国家获得运营牌照，依托轻资产海外模式实现高资本效率扩张，规模化落地能力已得到验证。随着 Robotaxi 海外收入占比持续提升、国内广州等城市单位经济效益转正，公司盈利路径逐渐清晰，当前估值反映了市场对其自动驾驶商业化落地进度的预期，后续核心观察点为海外车队扩张速度、国内城市落地范围扩大节奏以及 L2++ 量产项目的放量情况。 相关阅读： 《 商汤 2026 年前三季度营收 37.92 亿元，同比增长 30.4% 》 《 文远知行 2026 财年半年报归母亏损 7.9 亿元 》 风险提示： 本文内容由 AI 自动分析生成，仅供参考，不代表IT之家观点。如有出入请以证监会指定上市公司信息披露平台为准。本文内容不构成投资建议，如有投资者据此操作，风险自担，IT之家对此不承担任何责任。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 20 that WeRide released results for the first three quarters (January-September 2026) and the third fiscal quarter (July-September 2026) of fiscal year 2026 (January-December 2026). First three quarters: total revenue RMB 667 million, gross profit RMB 265 million, gross margin 39.6%, net loss attributable to shareholders RMB 1.1 billion, basic EPS -RMB 1.11, debt-to-asset ratio 20.55%. Third fiscal quarter: total revenue RMB 321 million, up 88% year on year and 38.8% quarter on quarter; gross profit RMB 138 million, gross margin 43%; net loss attributable to shareholders RMB 310 million, basic EPS -RMB 0.32. An AI-generated commentary in the article says results significantly beat market expectations, with quarterly revenue notably above the prior consensus estimate of RMB 270 million. On business lines, the company covers Robotaxi, L2++/L3 intelligent driving solutions and AI infrastructure, and also works on L4 applications such as Robobus and Robosweeper. In the third fiscal quarter, Robotaxi revenue exceeded RMB 100 million for the first time, up 204.0% year on year, with more than 90% of that coming from overseas business; Guangzhou Robotaxi operations achieved positive per-vehicle unit economics. Quarterly overseas revenue was RMB 147 million, up 171.5% year on year, accounting for 45.7% of total revenue; the company obtained Spain's first national-level L4 autonomous passenger vehicle operating license, expanded its Middle East fleet to about 600 vehicles, and became Uber's largest autonomous driving partner outside the United States. Cumulative deliveries of the WRD 3.0 L2++/L3 solution surpassed 100,000 units, with 10 new mass-production design wins added this quarter. Revenue at its Jingshuo Technology unit nearly doubled year on year. Third-quarter non-IFRS adjusted loss was RMB 337 million, EBITDA was -RMB 246.4 million, narrowing the year-on-year loss by 2.9%. As of September 30, 2026, cash and cash equivalents, time deposits, wealth management investments and restricted cash totaled RMB 4.663 billion, which management said can support more than four years of operations. The company operates in 13 countries and holds operating licenses in 9. The article notes the content was auto-generated by AI for reference only, does not represent IT之家's views, and that discrepancies should defer to the CSRC-designated disclosure platform; it is not investment advice.
items.why_zh: 这份财报显示文远知行营收与毛利率改善，但亏损规模仍然较大，其Robotaxi海外收入占比与单位经济效益转正情况，是观察自动驾驶商业化能否持续的重要指标（推测）。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，文远知行今日发布 2026 财年（2026 年 1 月～2026 年 12 月）前三季度（2026 年 1 月～2026 年 9 月）及第三财季（2026 年 7 月～2026 年 9 月）报告： 2026 财年前三季度 营业总收入 ：6.67 亿元 毛利润 ：2.65 亿元 毛利率 ：39.6% 归母净利润 ：-11 亿元 基本每股收益 ：-1.11 元 资产负债率 ：20.55% 2026 财年第三财季 营业总收入 ：3.21 亿元，同比增长 88%，环比增长 38.8% 毛利润 ：1.38 亿元 毛利率 ：43% 归母净利润 ：-3.1 亿元 基本每股收益 ：-0.32 元 资产负债率 ：20.55% AI 解读 文远知行 2026 年第三季度及前三季度业绩大幅超出市场机构预期，单季营收显著高于此前机构一致预期的 2.7 亿元水平，盈利能力提升幅度超预期。 公司业务与本季核心亮点 文远知行是全球领先的自动驾驶科技公司，业务覆盖 Robotaxi、L2++/L3 智能驾驶解决方案、AI 基础设施三大板块，同时布局 Robobus、Robosweeper 等 L4 级应用场景。 单第三财季：单季总营收达 3.22 亿元，同比增长 88%，环比增长 38.8%；毛利率提升至 43%，同比提升 10.1% 个百分点；Robotaxi 单季收入首次突破人民币 1 亿元，同比增长 204.0%，其中来自海外业务的收入占比超过 90%；广州 Robotaxi 运营实现单车单位经济效益转正。 前三季度累计：前三季度累计营收达 6.67 亿元，累计毛利润为 2.65 亿元，累计毛利率为 39.6%。 海外业务高速增长：单季海外业务收入达 1.47 亿元，同比增长 171.5%，占总收入的 45.7%；获得西班牙首张国家级 L4 级自动驾驶乘用车运营牌照，中东车队规模扩展至约 600 辆，成为 Uber 在美国以外最大的自动驾驶合作伙伴。 量产业务加速落地：WRD 3.0 L2++/L3 解决方案累计交付突破 10 万套，本季度新增 10 个量产定点，搭载该方案的多款量产车型已上市。 AI 基础设施业务翻倍增长：旗下景烁科技面向具身智能、机器人、自动驾驶客户提供全链路数据解决方案，业务收入同比增长近一倍。 盈利与现金流情况 单第三财季毛利润为 1.38 亿元，期内亏损为 3.1 亿元，非国际财务报告准则经调整期内亏损为 3.37 亿元，EBITDA 为 -246.4 百万元，较去年同期亏损收窄 2.9%；每股普通股基本及摊薄亏损为 0.32 元。 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，公司持有现金及现金等价物、定期存款、理财产品投资及受限制现金合计 46.63 亿元，管理层表示现有现金储备可支撑四年以上运营，足以支持公司实现自我造血。 展望与投资价值 公司当前已在 13 个国家开展运营、9 个国家获得运营牌照，依托轻资产海外模式实现高资本效率扩张，规模化落地能力已得到验证。随着 Robotaxi 海外收入占比持续提升、国内广州等城市单位经济效益转正，公司盈利路径逐渐清晰，当前估值反映了市场对其自动驾驶商业化落地进度的预期，后续核心观察点为海外车队扩张速度、国内城市落地范围扩大节奏以及 L2++ 量产项目的放量情况。 相关阅读： 《 商汤 2026 年前三季度营收 37.92 亿元，同比增长 30.4% 》 《 文远知行 2026 财年半年报归母亏损 7.9 亿元 》 风险提示： 本文内容由 AI 自动分析生成，仅供参考，不代表IT之家观点。如有出入请以证监会指定上市公司信息披露平台为准。本文内容不构成投资建议，如有投资者据此操作，风险自担，IT之家对此不承担任何责任。

items.summary_zh: 2026年11月18日，交易员在纽约证券交易所早盘交易时段工作。图片来源：Getty Images。英伟达临时CEO Colette Kress在周二晚结束这家陷入困境的芯片公司第三季度财报电话会议时表示：“我们能搞定。”到周四，公司股价徘徊在每股约150美元，较10月6日的历史高点下跌近40%，抹去了周二晚财报发布后的短暂上涨。与此同时，华尔街正为英伟达最大客户之一支付溢价：Anthropic以每股111.50美元在纳斯达克上市，比预期高出34%。仅看财报数字，英伟达本季度表现亮眼。第三季度营收较去年同期增长一倍多……完整报道见 The Verge。
items.summary_en: Traders work on the floor of the New York Stock Exchange during morning trading on November 18, 2026 in New York City. | Image: Getty Images "We've got this," Colette Kress, interim CEO of Nvidia, said Tuesday night as she closed out the embattled chip company's third quarter earnings call. By Thursday, the company's stock price was hovering at around $150 per share, a nearly 40 percent drop from its all-time high on October 6th, and wiping out a brief post-earnings pop on Tuesday night. Meanwhile, Wall Street was paying up for one of Nvidia's biggest customers as Anthropic made its Nasdaq debut at $111.50 per share - 34 percent higher than expected. items.title_en: Meta’s Muse Charm might cost $300
items.summary_zh: 据 The Information 报道，Meta 计划将 Muse Charm 定价为 300 美元；这是一款带屏幕的小型设备，可让用户与 Muse AI 智能体聊天。CEO Mark Zuckerberg 今年早些时候展示了该设备，并表示公司预计“赶在12月假日季”发货，但当时未公布价格。Zuckerberg 在发布 Muse Charm 时表示，公司已将“完整的 Muse 体验”，包括实时语音和虚拟形象技术，装入该设备。它配有指纹传感器，轻触即可与 Muse AI 智能体对话，无需解锁手机或打开应用。……完整报道见 The Verge。
items.summary_en: Meta is planning to price the Muse Charm, a little gadget with a screen that lets you chat with your Muse AI agent, at $300, according to The Information . CEO Mark Zuckerberg revealed the gadget earlier this year and said the company expected to ship the Charm "in time for the holidays in December," but he didn't provide a price at the time. When he announced the Muse Charm, Zuckerberg said that the company had "packed the whole Muse experience," including real-time voice and avatar technology, into the gadget. It has a fingerprint sensor, and you can tap it to be able to talk to a Muse AI agent without unlocking a phone or opening an app. … Read the full story at The Verge.
items.why_zh: 若定价属实，300美元的AI伴侣设备将检验消费者是否愿意为专用AI硬件买单，并加剧与手机AI助手的竞争（推测）。
items.why_en: If the price is accurate, a $300 AI companion device would test whether consumers pay for dedicated AI hardware and intensify competition with phone-based AI assistants (speculative).
